attchmntText: AVG Logistics Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: AVG Logistics Limited filed a notice with the National Stock Exchange and BSE regarding the publication of un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company published these results in the Financial Express in English and Jansatta in Hindi. The filing was made pursuant to Regulation 47 of SEBI LODR Regulations 2015. Sanjay Gupta, Managing Director with DIN 00527801, signed the letter on November 14, 2026. The document serves as a record of the newspaper publication. No financial figures or voting results are included in this specific correspondence.

attchmntText: AVG Logistics Limited has informed the Exchange about statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: AVG Logistics Limited filed a statement of no deviation or variation regarding the utilization of funds raised through a rights issue on June 10, 2026. The total amount raised was Rs. 52,93,01,620. The report covers the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Brickwork Ratings India Private Limited is the monitoring agency. There is no deviation in the use of funds. Funds were allocated for working capital requirements and general corporate purposes. Rs. 1060.00 lakhs were utilized for working capital. Rs. 504.00 lakhs were utilized for general corporate purposes. An excess expenditure of approximately Rs. 4 lakhs was covered by interest earned on fixed deposits created from the issue proceeds. The total funds raised have been utilized as of September 30, 2026. Sanjay Gupta, Managing Director, signed the report on November 13, 2026.

attchmntText: Monitoring Agency Report for utilisation of issue proceeds from Rights Issue for the Quarter ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: AVG Logistics Limited filed the Final Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, pursuant to Regulation 32(6) of SEBI Listing Regulations. Brickwork Ratings India Private Limited issued the report regarding the utilization of funds from a Rights Issue aggregating Rs.52.93 Crore. The funds were raised at Rs.145 per share, totaling 36,50,356 equity shares. The report confirms no deviation from the objects disclosed in the Offer Document. All proceeds were fully utilized by the end of the quarter. Rs.40.00 Crore was allocated to augment working capital requirements, Rs.11.83 Crore for general corporate purposes, and Rs.1.10 Crore for issue expenses. No unutilized funds remain. The company states that all government and statutory approvals related to the objects have been obtained. There are no material deviations or delays in implementation.

attchmntText: AVG Logistics Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: AVG Logistics Limited announced the outcome of its Board meeting held on November 13, 2026. The Board approved the unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. A limited review report was issued by statutory auditors. The consolidated profit for the half year was 708.88 lakhs. Revenue from operations stood at 15,162.32 lakhs for the quarter. The company recognized a gain of 2,119.41 lakhs from the termination of a lease agreement with Indian Railways. Carbonlite Logistics Private Limited was incorporated as a joint venture. The Board meeting commenced at 03:30 P.M. and concluded at 5:00 P.M. Sanjay Gupta, Managing Director, signed the communication.
